notes: EW-DX is a modular wireless-mic product family (bodypack/handheld transmitters plus 2-ch half-rack 'EM 2' and 4-ch full-rack 'EM 4' receivers, with plain and Dante variants). This entry represents the EW-DX EM 2 two-channel half-rack (9.5") receiver, the family's most I/O-complete unit, per Sennheiser's own hosted spec page (docs.cloud.sennheiser.com) plus the official EM2 PDF datasheet and corroborating B&H Photo specs. Audio outputs: each of the 2 channels has a balanced XLR-3M (max +18 dBu) and an unbalanced 1/4" TS (max +12 dBu) output. Power: 12V DC via external power-supply brick (barrel connector) OR Power-over-Ethernet (802.3af Class 0, <=1A) via the RJ-45 port — the RJ-45 is also used for network control/monitoring (Sennheiser Control Cockpit / Wireless Systems Manager), hence marked bidirectional; Ethernet speed grade (100Base-TX) reflects the spec's explicit IEEE802.3/100Base-TX callout. Rack size given as 1U for a half-rack (9.5") chassis; two units mount side-by-side in a full 19" 1U space. The half-rack unit ships with rack-mount ears/kit and a universal external power supply (EU/US/UK adapters). Dante variant (EW-DX EM 2 DANTE) adds a second RJ-45 for Dante audio networking and is a separate SKU not covered here. Headphone jack physical size (3.5mm vs 6.3mm) could not be explicitly confirmed from the fetched text excerpts; marked as an inferred/lower-confidence detail. This is a rackmount receiver, not the whole EW-DX line (which also includes bodypack transmitter SK, handheld transmitters, and lavalier/handheld mic capsules) — treat this record as representative of the receiver hardware only.
